module_summary: AXI read-channel FIFO: AR channel passes through (FIFO_DELAY=0), while R-channel beats are packed into a pointer-based circular memory FIFO and output through a registered read stage.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO memory holding packed R beats: data, last, id, resp.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO write pointer advanced on each accepted master R beat.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO read pointer advanced when output stage consumes an entry.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag blocking writes and deasserting m_axi_rready.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag gating reads and invalidating read data.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data packed into FIFO entries.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Master read valid triggering FIFO write when not full.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master read ready, asserted while FIFO not full.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Slave read data unpacked from output register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave read valid from output register stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave read ready allowing output register reload.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address passed through to master AR channel.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave AR valid bypassed to m_axi_arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: Master AR ready bypassed to s_axi_arready.

anchors.name: m_axi_r
anchors.why: Packed R-channel word written into FIFO memory.

anchors.name: write
anchors.why: FIFO memory write enable.

anchors.name: read
anchors.why: FIFO memory read enable loading mem_read_data_reg.

anchors.name: mem_read_data_reg
anchors.why: Registered memory read data before output register.

anchors.name: mem_read_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Valid flag for memory read stage data.

anchors.name: store_output
anchors.why: Loads output register and permits next FIFO read.

anchors.name: s_axi_r_reg
anchors.why: Output register holding packed R word for slave port.

groups.name: R FIFO memory
groups.description: Circular buffer with full/empty from extended write/read pointers.

groups.name: Read output stage
groups.description: Two-register read path presenting FIFO entries to slave R channel.

groups.name: Master R input
groups.description: Accepts master R beats when FIFO has space.

groups.name: AR passthrough
groups.description: AR channel wired directly from slave to master.
